gaps: EA_WCS_SESSION_TRUST_ENV_GAP
The EA sampler creates requests.Session without disabling trust_env, so proxy and netrc environment configuration can affect official WCS traffic.
Set trust_env=False, clear proxy/auth state, and receipt the effective transport policy.
EA_WCS_BASE_URL_ALLOWLIST_GAP
--wcs-url accepts an arbitrary value without requiring HTTPS or the pinned Environment Agency host and path.
Require the exact approved HTTPS origin/path or an explicitly pinned equivalent endpoint.
EA_WCS_REDIRECT_FINAL_IDENTITY_GAP
Capabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage follow redirects without checking final scheme, host, path or redirect count.
Require bounded redirects and revalidate the final HTTPS service identity after every request.
EA_WCS_STREAMING_SIZE_GATE_GAP
Response size is checked only after response.content has materialized the full body; stream=False is explicit for metadata and GetCoverage also reads the full content first.
Stream with Content-Length and aggregate byte ceilings before buffering or MemoryFile creation.
EA_WCS_XML_MEDIA_SCHEMA_GAP
Capabilities and DescribeCoverage responses are parsed without required XML media type, WCS version, root element or schema-conformance checks.
Require XML media type, exact WCS 2.0.1 service/version identity and schema-valid expected roots.
EA_DESCRIBE_COVERAGE_ID_BINDING_GAP
DescribeCoverage output is not required to contain exactly the requested CoverageId and matching coverage description.
Bind the response coverage identity and reject missing, duplicate or mismatched descriptions.
EA_AXIS_LABEL_FAIL_OPEN_GAP
Missing axis labels fall back to E and N instead of failing closed.
Require explicit axis labels from the requested coverage description; no guessed fallback.
EA_AXIS_LABEL_SEMANTIC_ORDER_GAP
The first two axisLabels are used without proving they are distinct easting/northing axes or matched to envelope/grid order.
Normalize and bind axis semantics, order, units and CRS dimensions before constructing subsets.
EA_SUBSET_BOUNDS_PADDING_RANGE_GAP
Polygon bounds, padding and generated subset limits are not checked for finiteness, ordering, GB range or request-size ceilings.
Require finite valid bounds, bounded positive padding and maximum width/height/area before request construction.
EA_RASTER_BAND_SCHEMA_GAP
Sampling reads data[0] without requiring exactly one elevation band, an approved dtype or a declared elevation range field.
Require one expected elevation band, approved numeric dtype and range-field identity.
EA_RASTER_RESOLUTION_ROTATION_GAP
The raster CRS is checked but 1 m resolution, zero rotation/skew, north-up orientation and finite affine terms are not enforced.
Require an approximately 1 x 1 metre north-up affine transform with zero rotation and bounded tolerance.
EA_RASTER_SCALE_OFFSET_UNITS_GAP
Band scale, offset and unit metadata are not verified before values are treated as metres ODN.
Require scale 1, offset 0, metre units and explicit ODN vertical metadata or a pinned equivalent contract.
EA_RASTER_MASK_NODATA_CONTRACT_GAP
The sampler relies on the masked array plus an arbitrary floor but does not bind nodata, dataset mask, alpha or validity flags to the coverage contract.
Validate nodata and mask semantics, reject alpha/extra validity ambiguity and record valid-mask provenance.
EA_RASTER_BOUNDS_PIXEL_CENTER_COVERAGE_GAP
The returned raster bounds and pixel-centre grid are not required to cover the padded request and exact polygon envelope.
Verify bounds, dimensions and pixel-centre alignment cover the requested subset without truncation.
EA_HMLR_INPUT_EXACT_IDENTITY_GAP
The EA polygon loader requires three matched rows but not the exact target row set, distinct parcel/HMLR IDs, task, attempt, continuation or source hash.
Bind the exact three row-parcel-HMLR tuples and generation identity before any WCS request.
EA_HMLR_GEOMETRY_VALIDITY_AREA_GAP
Polygon type and non-empty checks do not require valid geometry, positive finite area, finite coordinates or expected bounds.
Require valid native geometry, positive bounded area and finite coordinate/bounds checks.
EA_OUTPUT_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_ATOMIC_GAP
EA output omits task, attempt, continuation and generation and is written directly without durable atomic replacement.
Publish a strict generation-bound receipt through unique temp, flush, atomic replace and remote readback.
EA_PROVENANCE_HEADERS_RECEIPT_GAP
GetCoverage records resolved URL and body hash but not final host, status, media type, Content-Length, ETag or Last-Modified.
Record and validate complete response identity and cache/provenance headers.
NUMERIC_SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT_GAP
The numeric orchestrator subprocess.run calls have no timeout for EA, metric, Terrain50 or web stages.
Apply stage-specific bounded timeouts and process-tree cleanup with explicit timeout receipts.
NUMERIC_STAGE_OUTPUT_IDENTITY_GAP
Stage success uses exit code and selected status fields without binding task, attempt, continuation, generation, input hashes and fresh output mtime/hash.
Require a fresh generation manifest and exact child hashes for every stage output.
NUMERIC_CROSS_STAGE_PARCEL_ID_BINDING_GAP
Cross-stage validation compares HMLR IDs but not parcel IDs across EA, metric and Terrain50 rows.
Require exact row-parcel-HMLR identity equality across all numeric stages.
NUMERIC_DUPLICATE_ROW_OVERWRITE_GAP
Dictionary comprehensions keyed by row_no silently overwrite duplicate EA, metric or Terrain50 rows before exact-set validation.
Reject duplicates before indexing and require exactly three raw row objects.
NUMERIC_STAGE_SAFETY_FLAG_BINDING_GAP
Numeric success does not require every child payload and row to carry fake_data=false, final_ready=false and blocked/error absence.
Bind strict safety flags and status/error schema at child and row level.
NUMERIC_TOLERANCE_AND_WEB_FULL_GATE_GAP
Metric tolerance is not checked for finite positive bounded range, and outer web acceptance does not require all verifier booleans such as source/example counts and exact-binding receipt flags.
Validate tolerance and expected-row arguments, then require the complete web acceptance flag set and generation-bound receipt.
